facts.fact: 【动作】Phil 在教师休息室批改翻译作业时，一张画着黑色圆圈的活页纸从练习册里滑落到地上，她捡了起来。
facts.anchor: A piece of paper slipped out and fluttered to the floor

facts.fact: 【动作】英语教师 Dr Tregennis 告诉 Phil，她被人递了“黑点”警告。
facts.anchor: you have been slipped the Black Spot

facts.fact: 【动作】Jane Worth 说学生缠着她、要求加课，还想让她开课外学习小组。
facts.anchor: They follow me. They pester me. They ask me for additional lessons.

facts.fact: 【动作】四年级课上 Anne 举手问一个拉丁词，一条猩红色的蛇从她袖口滑出，爬到 Phil 的桌上。
facts.anchor: A serpent’s head glided out from the cuff of Anne’s sleeve

facts.fact: 【动作】Phil 命 Anne 把蛇收走，并把那句拉丁文抄二十遍。
facts.anchor: impudentiam summam aut stultitiam singularem sentence for me twenty times

facts.fact: 【动作】两晚后 Phil 夜间巡查，循雪茄烟味走上螺旋石梯，被人在后腰推入一间空屋，门从外面锁上。
facts.anchor: The shove in the small of her back took her by surprise

facts.fact: 【动作】校长的柯基犬 Faust 在门外把钥匙转动，Phil 得以开门出来。
facts.anchor: very slowly, the key began to turn

facts.fact: 【动作】Phil 踹翻烟灰缸，又逐支踩灭雪茄。
facts.anchor: stamping on each cigar individually to put it out

facts.fact: 【关系】Dr Tregennis 是这所学校的英语教师，与 Phil、Jane Worth 同处一间教师休息室。
facts.anchor: The English teacher Dr Tregennis was snoozing by the empty fireplace

facts.fact: 【关系】Phil 的父亲用莎士比亚剧作给两个女儿取名 Philomela 和 Cressida。
facts.anchor: named his daughters Philomela and Cressida

facts.fact: 【关系】Faust 是校长（Head）养的柯基犬。
facts.anchor: which she recognized as coming from the Head’s corgi

facts.fact: 【关系】Anne 是 Phil 所教四年级班上的学生。
facts.anchor: It was the fourth year again.

facts.fact: 【数字】Phil 罚 Anne 把那句拉丁文连同预习一起抄二十遍。
facts.anchor: twenty times, along with your preparation

facts.fact: 【数字】从 Anne 袖口滑出的蛇在桌上扭动时已有接近半码长。
facts.anchor: nearly half a yard of it writhing across her desk

facts.fact: 【数字】Phil 开始夜巡时已过午夜。
【数字】Phil 巡夜经过一间住着十五岁女生的宿舍。
